content: DFTB.org and DFTB+ Recipes agree that Slater-Koster parameter files are per ordered element pair, contain Hamiltonian/overlap tables plus optional repulsive splines, and require explicit max angular momentum because the historical SKF format does not reliably encode included valence orbitals. The slakoformat technical guide states that an initial @ indicates extended format supporting angular momenta through f, while non-@ files are the simple format through d.
